urdf_units: ROS-required SI: m, kg, kg*m^2, rad. Engineering data is separately preserved in g/mm/g*mm^2.
scope: RViz/kinematic visualization candidate. Mass/inertia are estimates based on CAD and agreed density assumptions, not measurements.
gripper: Equivalent opposite linear finger motion with right=-left mimic; internal crank linkage and motor-angle-to-gap mapping not simulated.
arm_limits: Unverified provisional references remain in ROBOT_REVIEW_PENDING.json. Continuous CAD joints do not assert unlimited real motion.
actuator_effort_velocity: Effort=0 until configured from verified hardware data. Velocity entries are provisional visualization values, not verified hardware limits.
collision: Visual mesh reuse, not convex decomposition validated for Isaac/PhysX dynamics.
scripts: ModularURDFReady.py is a WaffleExport internal module requiring its original API context. finalize_urdf_261021.py and audit_urdf_261021.py run standalone with Python+NumPy on this bundle. Run finalize then audit after regenerating the generic export.
